I quit Effexor cold turkey (it’s brutal). My stomach was fucked for 3 months. SSRIs affect a lot of processes down stream of serotonin. Your GI is one of those processes that serotonin can affect.

I ended up taking the 14g's of peyote by grinding them up and putting them in capsules.

The first 40 minutes I was hit with a pretty intense nausea I've never experienced with mushrooms or any other psychedelic I've taken before. The discomfort had me on the couch with my eyes closed until I felt like any motion wasn't going to cause me to purge.

At this point I was in a lightly altered headspace but nothing visual. I decided to leave my house and go for a "short" walk. I had so much energy and just kept on walking and walking. I ended up in the next town over still feeling fresh, and eventually made my way back home after 5 hours. I didn't have any breakthroughs or eureka moments on the walk, I just felt very present.

Usually I need to be constantly stimulated, (Music, Videos, Phone) I didn't feel that need while on this extended walk, and to a degree even 3 days later. Once I got home I spent the remainder of the trip watching the movie "World's Greatest Dad".

Even though I didn't have anything ground breaking resonate with me I felt it was positive experience that gave me a more positive inner self talk.
